replacement: “Smerdyakov always shoves his way in now, after dinner. It’s you he’s so keen on. What have you done to charm him?” he added, to Ivan.
“Well, I’m leaving. You’ve had too much brandy.”

“What are you staring at me for? Why do you look like that? Your eyes look at me and say, ‘You ugly drunk!’ Your eyes don’t trust me. They’re full of contempt....
